spots.name: Beqa Island
spots.bio_draft: island: lagoon island 10 km off Viti Levu, base for shark dives and firewalking villages, reached by boat from Pacific Harbour
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base. (spot comes from region fiji-kadavu)

spots.name: Kadavu Island
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: island: the base for the whole Kadavu group, a destination rather than a spot
spots.reason: Kadavu has only three other kept places (Great Astrolabe Reef, Nabukelevu, Kavala Bay Waterfall): below the four-spot bar, so the island is a standalone island spot (like Kapiti Island) and its three draws stand alone beside it. Owner: if the 10 review candidates (Naiqoro Passage, Namalata Bay, Soso Passage, beaches...) are approved, promote Kadavu to a destination.

spots.name: Great Astrolabe Reef
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: reef: barrier reef with 60+ dive and snorkel sites, the island's principal draw
spots.reason: Barrier reef with 60+ dive/snorkel sites off Kadavu; reached by boat from Kadavu resorts; no destination within reach.

spots.name: Kavala Bay Waterfall
spots.bio_draft: waterfall: 45-minute climb to a high waterfall with a swimming hole, reached by boat through mangroves at high tide
spots.reason: 45-minute climb reached by boat on Kadavu; no destination within reach.

spots.name: Nabukelevu
spots.bio_draft: mountain: 805 m inactive volcano and highest point of Kadavu, known as Mount Washington
spots.reason: Mount Washington, Kadavu high point; no destination within reach.

folded_or_merged.name: Kadavu Island
folded_or_merged.reason: Placed as standalone island spot kadavu-island (below the four-spot bar).
